evidence: CVEProject cvelistV5 https://raw.githubusercontent.com/CVEProject/cvelistV5/main/cves/2026/72xxx/CVE-2026-72764.json is state PUBLISHED (not rejected/withdrawn). CWE-668. Vendor advisory GHSA-9cmh-xcqm-5hqr. Fixed versions 1.123.67, 2.31.5, 2.32.1.

Vendor advisory https://github.com/n8n-io/n8n/security/advisories/GHSA-9cmh-xcqm-5hqr (published 2026-07-22, not withdrawn) describes a persistent JS task runner sharing one Node module cache across users' Code-node executions so a Code-node user can poison a cached allowlisted module and alter later users' executions. Scope is a cross-user isolation break, not a sandbox escape/RCE. Condition: multi-user instance with NODE_FUNCTION_ALLOW_BUILTIN or NODE_FUNCTION_ALLOW_EXTERNAL enabled.

Source-to-sink at n8n@1.123.66 (205a227df8a488f45fbac2f39ce8b57fb5380e25): packages/@n8n/task-runner/src/js-task-runner/require-resolver.ts returns require(request) as unknown after the allowlist check; JsTaskRunner constructs one createRequireResolver on the persistent runner and injects it as require into each VM context via buildContext. Node's module cache is process-wide, so a mutation of the returned export is visible to later tasks on the same runner.

Mainline 27d83e0d918f5009101bb27bb09ea8c6374a11d9 (feat: Initial Code Task Runners support (no-changelog) (#10698)) is the first released squash that contains packages/@n8n/task-runner-node-js/src/code.ts with VM context require. It is a 28-member squash aggregate and is not an atomic BIC.
